name: Spring Breakdown
tagline: Lonely penguins, clingy monkeys & one sad horse

cards.name: Dubai Chewy Cookie
cards.caption: Sold out in 15 minutes
cards.flavor: Jan 2026: Korea lined up at dawn for 'dujjonku,' a pistachio-marshmallow cookie craze.
cards.art: Wikimedia Commons photo of a Dubai chewy cookie cut in half: cocoa-dusted marshmallow shell around green pistachio-kataifi filling, in a paper cup.

cards.name: Reginald Skulinski
cards.caption: *chews in disappointment*
cards.flavor: Apr 2026: Skull from Monster House (2006), mid-chew and staring, became the face of dread.
cards.art: Still of Reginald 'Skull' Skulinski from Monster House chewing and staring wide-eyed, from the meme's most-shared reaction image.

cards.name: Bowie Knife99
cards.caption: Off the track. On you.
cards.flavor: May 2026: an AI rival in Forza Horizon 6 rammed so many players he became its villain.
cards.art: Forza Horizon 6 gameplay frame: an orange supercar at night under the floating 'bowie knife99' nametag (Know Your Meme's main image).

cards.name: He Is 20 Years Old
cards.caption: He is only 20 years old
cards.flavor: June 2026: one headshot of Backrooms director Kane Parsons ran in every story. So: memes.
cards.art: Kane Parsons' press headshot: curly hair, faint smile, plain olive background (Know Your Meme's main image).

cards.name: Big Arch Burger Test
cards.caption: Mm. Delicious product.
cards.flavor: Feb 2026: McDonald's CEO took one tiny bite of the Big Arch and called it 'product.'
cards.art: Frame from Chris Kempczinski's Instagram review: the McDonald's CEO in a cream sweater, mid-bite into the Big Arch burger.

cards.name: DLSS 5 On
cards.caption: Now with free AI makeup
cards.flavor: Mar 16, 2026: Nvidia showed off AI graphics. Gamers saw a beauty filter and memed it.
cards.art: The 'DLSS 5 on' half of Nvidia's demo comparison: Resident Evil Requiem's Grace Ashcroft, glossy and glammed up in a rainy alley.

cards.name: Your AI Slop Bores Me
cards.caption: As a large human model...
cards.flavor: Mar 2026: a site where humans play the chatbot and scribble answers. 280 million hits.
cards.art: The youraislopbores.me logo: a big black hand-drawn scribble on white (Know Your Meme's main image).

cards.name: Crying Horse
cards.caption: How I look at work
cards.flavor: Jan 2026: a lucky horse plush got its smile sewn on upside down. China bought 15,000/day.
cards.art: News photo of the red Year of the Horse plush with its frown sewn on upside down, held up in a Yiwu toy shop.

cards.name: Du Bist Gut Genug
cards.caption: Du bist gut genuuuuug
cards.flavor: June 2026: Rayan's falsetto hook went global on TikTok and the song hit No. 1 in Germany.
cards.art: Black-and-white music video still of Blumengarten singer Rayan mid-note in glasses and a leather jacket (Know Your Meme's main image, cropped).

cards.name: Rahhhhh
cards.caption: Me when the wifi drops
cards.flavor: Skeleton Banging Shield: Skyrim undead, a roar and a Half-Life clang. Jan 2026's top meme.
cards.art: The Skyrim skeleton on black, sword raised, skull screaming behind its round bronze shield (Know Your Meme's explainer image).

cards.name: Nihilist Penguin
cards.caption: Me leaving the group chat
cards.flavor: Jan 2026: Herzog's 2007 penguin, marching alone to the mountains, became burnout's mascot.
cards.art: Vertical frame from Encounters at the End of the World: a lone Adélie penguin walking across the ice toward snowy mountains.

cards.name: Punch the Monkey
cards.caption: Emotional support IKEA
cards.flavor: Feb 2026: Punch, a baby macaque at a Japanese zoo, clung to an IKEA orangutan. So did we.
cards.art: Photo of Punch, the baby Japanese macaque, sitting on his orange orangutan plush and looking back at the camera (Wikimedia Commons).
